name: lottie
title: Lottie
summary: Plays a Lottie animation (an After Effects export, e.g. from LottieFiles) at a spot in the frame, frame-exact. Drop the .json in the video's animations/lottie/ folder; works as an overlay too.

fields.label: Lottie file
fields.help: A .json in the video's animations/lottie/ folder.
